class.name: RealityKitEnvironmentLightingConfiguration
class.brief_description: Controls how much the system environment lighting affects a node and its descendants.
class.description:
On visionOS, the lighting of the surrounding real-world environment (AR image-based lighting) is combined with the image-based lighting defined by the app. RealityKitEnvironmentLightingConfiguration controls how much the system lighting contributes to the content it applies to.
The configuration applies to its parent node and all the descendants of that node. Only one RealityKitEnvironmentLightingConfiguration is supported per parent. A configuration nested deeper in the tree overrides the one above it.
If the parent is a [WorldEnvironment], the configuration applies to the whole scene.
To configure the lighting of a [RealityImageBasedLight3D], add the configuration as a sibling of the [RealityImageBasedLight3D]: [codeblock] MySubScene |- RealityImageBasedLight3D |- RealityKitEnvironmentLightingConfiguration |- MeshInstance3D [/codeblock]
This translates to a RealityKit [url=https://developer.apple.com/documentation/realitykit/environmentlightingconfigurationcomponent]EnvironmentLightingConfigurationComponent[/url].

members.member: How much the system environment lighting contributes to the lighting of the content, from [code]0.0[/code] (none) to [code]1.0[/code] (full).
